title: Unnamed Raytheon engineer and academic experts consulted on the Gimbal video
place_text: Off the US East Coast (Gimbal video)

tellings.quote: So, let me just run through. So, we talked to a ra a senior Rathon engineer who was, let's say, intimately familiar with the system.

plain: A writer named Marik von Rennenkampff says that, to make sense of the Gimbal video, a video of an unexplained object recorded off the US East Coast, he and others consulted experts, including a senior engineer at the defence firm Raytheon who was "intimately familiar with the system" that filmed it, along with academics. He says it on the show during a debate with a skeptic, and he does not name the engineer. The point of telling it is that people who know the camera system would be best placed to say whether the video shows something real or a quirk of the equipment.
